SETTINGS.TITLE: Response Bot
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Configure the AI bot that automatically responds to customers and classifies conversations.

SEATS.TITLE: Available Acentos
SEATS.DESCRIPTION: Acentos fonéticos del agente IA. Configurados por el administrador del sistema.
SEATS.EMPTY: No hay acentos activos. Contacta al administrador del sistema.

ROLES.DESCRIPTION: Roles que definen el comportamiento y propósito del agente IA.
ROLES.EMPTY: No hay roles activos. Contacta al administrador del sistema.

CONFIG.TITLE: Bot Configuration
CONFIG.LIST_DESCRIPTION: Each inbox can have one bot configuration. Create a configuration per inbox you want to automate.
CONFIG.EMPTY: No configurations yet. Create one to start automating responses.
CONFIG.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the configuration for "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
CONFIG.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: ej. Bot para bandeja de ventas
CONFIG.ENABLED_HINT: When enabled, the bot will respond to all incoming messages in this inbox.
CONFIG.LABELS_HINT: The bot will classify conversations using the enabled labels.
CONFIG.MODEL_PLACEHOLDER: Seleccione un modelo (o use el predeterminado)...
CONFIG.MODEL_HINT: Used for conversation classification and replies.
CONFIG.AUDIO_MODEL_PLACEHOLDER: Seleccione un modelo (o use el modelo de texto)...
CONFIG.AUDIO_MODEL_HINT: Used to transcribe voice messages via Whisper.
CONFIG.IMAGE_MODEL_PLACEHOLDER: Seleccione un modelo (o use el modelo de texto)...
CONFIG.IMAGE_MODEL_HINT: Used to analyze images sent by customers. Falls back to the text model.
CONFIG.MAPS_API_KEY_HINT: Used to calculate delivery distance between addresses.
CONFIG.PRICE_PER_KM_HINT: Delivery cost charged per km from company address.
CONFIG.SETUP_LABELS_HINT: Creates the selected labels in your Jabvox account if they do not exist.

DOCUMENTS.TITLE: Documents
DOCUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Upload documents to the Minio bucket (same as AI Chat), then sync them here. Assign each document to a category so the bot uses it as context when responding.

DOCUMENTS.EMPTY: No documents yet. Configure your bucket in AI Chat settings and click Sync.
